The '''elderly speaker''' is a character {{In|FOTV}}.

==Background==
An elderly [[Vault 33]] dweller who was seen wearing a ceremonial [[stole]] over his [[vault suit (TV series)|vault suit]] while officiating weddings.

==''Fallout'' TV series==
In the series premiere episode "[[The End (episode)|The End]]", the elderly speaker officiates the wedding of [[Lucy MacLean]] and [[Monty (TV series)|Monty]]. Lucy later finds him dead, having been killed and impaled to the wall of the armory by a [[Vault 32 raider|raider]] with a [[machete (TV series)|machete]].

==Appearances==
The elderly speaker appears only {{in|FOTV}}.
{{FOTV appearances|1=101}}

==Notes==
* While the [[stole]] worn by this character resembles that worn by [[Christianity|Christian]] clergy of various denominations, him being a priest is never directly stated in the series (he is credited only as "elderly speaker"), and instead of Christian symbols, it features the [[Vault-Tec]] logo.
* The large book he carries also features the Vault-Tec logo on the cover instead of any religious symbols. It might be a version of the Vault-Tec edition of the Bible, as featured in the ''[[Vault Seller's Survival Guide]]'' episode "[[Follow Your Nos!]]" (there with a cross on the cover in addition to the Vault-Tec logo).
